lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso, narrowing at the anterior shoulder and posterior rump transitions.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso; an isolated horizontal white dash is visible between the 4th and 5th vertical lines (counted from posterior) in the lower-mid lateral region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three high-contrast circular spots clustered on the lateral haunch, centered above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The three haunch spots form a distinct horizontal linear alignment across the mid-thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the facial infraorbital/muzzle area; a prominent white horizontal patch located on the ventral-cervical region; white contrast patches on the carpal and tarsal regions of the limbs.
